summary.text: Matt Walker, listed by Ballotpedia as Matthew Walker, is a Republican state representative from Franklin-4 who was appointed to the Vermont House of Representatives in February 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served on the House Transportation Committee in 2023-2024.

paragraphs.text: Matt Walker was appointed to the Vermont House to replace Brian Savage and assumed office on February 2, 2022.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026, and is one of two incumbents running for the two-seat Franklin-4 district.
